settings.editor: Support Mautic

settings.title: Help maintain the Mautic you rely on.

settings.editor: You use Mautic to run campaigns, work with customers or build your business. Behind the software are people reviewing contributions, coordinating releases, maintaining documentation and keeping the project running.
Your support helps fund that work, so Mautic can keep improving while remaining open source and community-led.
Compare the ways to support or donate monthly — a one-time donation is welcome too.
Supporting Mautic is voluntary. You do not need to pay the project to keep using the open-source software.

settings.title: Free to use does not mean free to maintain.

settings.editor: Volunteers contribute code, testing, documentation and advice. But a project also needs funded time to coordinate that work, maintain shared infrastructure and plan what comes next.

Regular contributions make that work easier to plan. A broader base of supporters also reduces reliance on a small number of organisations. For you, that means investing in the long-term maintenance of a tool you already depend on, rather than buying another software licence.

Help fund project leadership and contributor coordination, with support spread across the community rather than concentrated in a few organisations.

settings.title: Support personally, or through your company.

settings.editor: Choose a flexible donation if you want to help now. Choose membership if you also want to participate in Mautic's governance.
Best for: users, freelancers and contributors who want a voice in Mautic's future.
Individual membership combines annual support with voting rights under Mautic's governance rules. It is a way to participate in the project behind the software you use.

• Support Mautic annually
  • Participate in member voting
  • Regional rates shown before joining
Regional rates and the participatory route are shown on the membership page.
Best for: companies using Mautic internally, or earning revenue from Mautic services.
Corporate membership helps fund the shared project your business relies on. Your organisation receives recognition and voting rights, with additional benefits depending on the tier.

• Make support part of your annual budget
  • Show your company's commitment
  • Compare regional rates and tiers
Not the budget owner? Share the page with whoever owns your open-source budget.
Best for: supporting the project without becoming a member.
Donate an amount that fits your budget. Monthly contributions give the project more predictable support; a one-time donation is welcome too.

• Flexible financial support
  • No membership or voting rights
  • Handled through Open Collective
Prefer a one-off? Donate once instead.

settings.description_text: Mautic Partners are corporate members who also make sustained practical contributions. Partnership requires at least three months of consistent contribution and ongoing review — it is not a status you can obtain through payment alone.

items.item_title: Do I have to pay to keep using Mautic?
I already pay for Mautic hosting or services. Doesn't that fund the project?
What is the difference between a donation and membership?
Does supporting Mautic buy technical support or a particular feature?
Can my company request an invoice?

settings.editor: No. Financial support is voluntary. It helps maintain the project; it is not a licence fee or a payment to unlock features.

Not automatically. Paying a hosting provider or an agency pays that company for the service it provides to you. Some of those companies also support the project as members or partners, and you can check whether yours is one of them on the members and partners page. If it isn't, that is a good conversation to have with them.

A donation is financial support with no strings attached, in any amount, handled through Open Collective. Membership is an annual commitment that also carries rights under Mautic's governance rules — most importantly a vote in the General Assembly. If you want a say in the project's direction, you want membership.

No. Supporting the project is not a support contract, and it does not buy a place on the roadmap. What membership buys is participation in how those decisions get made. For technical support, the community forums are free, and a number of companies offer commercial support.
Yes. Email membership@mautic.org and we'll issue an invoice so you can pay in advance by bank transfer.

Yes, and it matters just as much. Code, testing, documentation, translation, design, support in the forums and community organising are all contributions. Start at contribute to Mautic. Regular contributors may also qualify for the free participatory route to individual membership.
